configuration.source: Runtime row source, partition id modulo keys, nullable sort value every 31 rows; sort values rise/fall by source-id/keys
configuration.measurement: Complete executeSql().await(), including source/sink, both transposes, JNI, all retained state and rank-update output
configuration.task_off_heap_budget: 48 GiB for each engine via the metrics fixture; a configured budget, not reserved or allocated physical memory
configuration.metrics_lifetime: One metrics reporter and local MiniCluster per job, closed after timing and native consumption assertion; no gauges retained across jobs. The JVM and its 2 GiB heap are shared across warmup/measured jobs.
configuration.state_backend: Flink default heap; resident native Top-N store

limitations: Separate JVM stock controls drift; cross-run comparisons are descriptive, not isolated attribution.
Every completed warmup and measured trial is retained.
Increasing and decreasing arrivals emit different quantities of rank changes; compare engines only within the same fixture.
No timing from the initial Criterion run overlapping the docs build is used.
Native recovery is compared with uninterrupted stock; the released heap host failed an injected restore with a missing prior accumulator.
